method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: Each panorama was anchored on one end of the house and its base row (cameras 2.6 m high); their shared windows disagreed by 0.5 m and the difference was split. The Fiskaregatan side is seen only at the corner and keeps the same rhythm.
